**Context:** Screening a 23-paper batch for the sports-science library, promoting one paper, then searching the web for more open-access papers.

**Key Exchanges:**
- All 19 DOI hits in the 23-paper batch were duplicates of papers already in the library under other file names. Q13, Q14 and Q20 had also been screened in earlier batches. Q22 was the only new paper.
- Q22 (injury history and countermovement jump) was DEGRADED in batch 13 because its PDF was unreadable. It reads now. The user approved promoting it to INCLUDE.
- Q22 was added as ID 1926 through draft PR #28. The user approved the merge, and the PR is merged. Master is at `3e4e167` and the audits pass. The next unused ID is 1927.
- The user asked for more papers and chose a web search. It found two new candidates, and the user approved fetching their full text:
  - `10.1186/s40798-025-00936-4`: meta-analysis, 8 studies, 2,571 athletes. Injury prevention programs cut concussion rates by about a third (RR 0.66, 95% CI 0.50 to 0.85).
  - `10.1038/s41598-026-70693-1`: meta-analysis, 14 RCTs, 693 athletes. A lengthening-focused rehab protocol may shorten return to play. Evidence on reinjury is weak.
- Two other search hits were already in the library: `10.1186/s40798-025-00952-4` and `10.1007/s40279-026-02417-4`.
- A background Google Drive search for source-paper folders was killed because the system was low on memory. I did not restart it, and it is not needed because the repo holds the full set.

**Decisions Made:**
- Q22 was promoted from DEGRADED to INCLUDE with human approval, since the audit flags double-screened papers.
- The two merge approvals came from the user. Nothing was merged without approval.
- The Drive search stays stopped unless the user asks for it.

**Lessons Learned:**
- The screening audit cannot supersede a record. To upgrade a paper, remove the old DEGRADED entry (here from `batch-13`) and add the INCLUDE.
- Check DOIs against the library before drafting a batch. Files with new names can still be duplicates of earlier screened papers, and the audit catches them.
- The Firecrawl account is low on credits, so full-text fetches cost more.
- The merge-cleanup hook deletes merged branches, so `batch-122-staged` will be removed automatically.

**Action Items:**
